scope: Distinguish enduring project identity from repository, folder, deployment, and implementation-surface aliases.

sources.meaning: Canonical state names the project Mirror Cartographer and the repository MirrorCartographer/mirror-cartographer-ui.
Current delivery work is scoped by queue item and owner, not by project rename.
Project-facing summary consistently names Mirror Cartographer.
Introductory project material consistently names Mirror Cartographer.
Long-form conceptual material consistently names Mirror Cartographer.
Historical implementation guidance used mirror-cartographer-ui, mirror-cartographer-ui-v2, mirror-cartographer-next, and mirror-cartographer as technical locations or repository candidates.

claims.claim: The enduring project name is Mirror Cartographer.
Historical implementation records contain multiple repository, folder, framework, and deployment labels.
Those labels describe implementation surfaces and migration attempts rather than separate project identities.
Future continuity artifacts should type names by role: project_name, repository_name, local_folder, deployment_name, package_name, branch, or historical_alias.
A repository or folder label change implies that the Mirror Cartographer project itself changed names.
Which historical implementation aliases remain active, abandoned, or redirected cannot be established from naming evidence alone.

identity_invariant.rule: Technical container names must not be promoted to project-name changes without an explicit project-level rename decision.

contradictions_resolved.contradiction: Historical logs sometimes called a technical folder or repository the working project name, while later project documents state that the project never changed names.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Mirror Cartographer is the project identity. Other labels are typed implementation aliases unless an explicit rename decision exists.

privacy_boundary.included: Project naming, repository and folder aliases, document titles, public repository metadata, and abstract continuity rules.
privacy_boundary.excluded: Raw private chat text, personal identity details, health, relationships, finances, and symbolic content unrelated to naming continuity.

next_action: Create a deterministic alias registry and scan historical artifacts for untyped names, assigning each occurrence a role and confidence without modifying canonical project identity.
